data.reasoning: The disagreement stems entirely from a tool error (HTTP 400) in the Qwen model's report, which failed to evaluate the PKGBUILD. The Deepseek model successfully reviewed all files and correctly identified the PKGBUILD as a standard, safe AUR -git package with no malicious injections. Treating the errored report as missing leaves the valid 'safe' verdict as the correct conclusion.
data.disagreement_analysis: Caused by an LLM API failure (HTTP 400) in the Qwen model during PKGBUILD review, resulting in an inconclusive file status. The Deepseek model completed the review successfully.
coverage_issues: Qwen model failed to audit the PKGBUILD due to an HTTP 400 API error.
learnings: Implement fallback logic or retries for transient API errors (like HTTP 400) during file reviews to prevent a single failed request from downgrading a package verdict to 'inconclusive' when an initial sourcing audit already passed.
